Challenge

An upscale building for investors who rent their units as short-term stays (Airbnb-style), across from Corferias, one of Bogotá's busiest commercial and business districts. It called for a much higher level of detail in design and finishes, and a facade that conveys luxury and quality.

Approach

A carefully detailed luxury building, with high-end finishes and a facade with a strong presence that suits its business setting.

BIM contribution

I designed the project, modeled the facade, architecture, and structure in Revit, and supported coordination.
